title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 381
paragraphs: The districts of the Calasirians are those of Thebes, Bubastis, Aphthis, Tanis, Mendes, Sebennytos, Athribis, Pharbaithos, Thmuïs, Onuphis, Anytis, and Myecphoris — this last being on an island opposite the city of Bubastis. These are the districts of the Calasirians; at their greatest strength they numbered two hundred and fifty thousand men. Nor is it lawful for them, any more than for the others, to practice any trade; rather they practice only the profession of war, handing down the tradition from father to son.
